component.name: Obsidian PostIt
component.summary: Quick diary and sticky notes from the KDE tray into an Obsidian vault

description.p: Obsidian PostIt lives in the system tray and captures quick notes and a daily journal straight into an Obsidian Markdown vault — without launching Obsidian. A continuous Diary holds one rolling file per device; standalone Notes are individual Markdown files with filenames guessed from content. Tags, live syntax highlighting, search, autostart, KDE global shortcuts, Todoist tasks, voice notes with a live transcript (local or OpenRouter) and optional OpenRouter AI (Summarize/Clean) are included. API tokens are kept in the system keyring, never in a config file.

description.p: Voice notes show the transcript live while you speak and can use either a local whisper.cpp model or an OpenRouter speech-to-text model. The local engine runs in a separate process so it can no longer crash the app. Settings are reorganised into tabs with grouped sections and clearer dropdowns.
Record a voice note from the tray menu; the local transcript is appended to today's daily note.
Refresh the README and screenshots for Diary navigation, Todoist links and KDE shortcuts.
Link created Todoist tasks from Diary entries and register KDE global shortcuts through the desktop portal.
Release Qt windows before shutdown to prevent a crash when quitting the tray app.
Browse the Diary one day at a time, open clipped notes from diary links, keep multiple notes open, and create Todoist tasks from explicitly marked diary entries.
Search notes doubles as a manager: delete a note in place with Del (an empty query lists recent notes).
Use trafilatura for web clipping — clean, article-focused text extraction across sites.
Better web clipping: isolate the article/main content and strip nav, headers, footers, scripts and styles so clips focus on the text.
Fix a crash when clipping a URL from the Diary: background work now runs on the thread pool and delivers results to the GUI thread safely.
Fix the opencode MCP registration to match its schema (type=local, command array).
Headless CLI, an MCP server for AI agents, web-page clipping into the diary (auto-clip bare URLs), and global-hotkey capture.
Initial release: Diary journal, sticky Notes, tags, search, autostart, and optional OpenRouter AI.
